purpose: Tier 1 / Tier 2 / Tier 3 review classification + reason codes for efficient human partnership. Tiers and reason codes appear in every emitted contract/CLI output that carries advisory intelligence.

tier_1.label: auto-eligible / lightweight review
tier_1.description: Deterministic, source-backed, low-impact advisory items. May be surfaced without mandatory human sign-off but are never actionable determinations.

tier_2.label: recommended review
tier_2.description: Strong-heuristic or partial-coverage items. Surfaced as advisory; human review recommended before action.

tier_3.label: mandatory review
tier_3.description: Model-only, low-confidence, unsupported, stale, conflicting, or sensitive/high-impact items. Never treated as an accepted fact and never auto-accepted.
